note: The bands the wing plant has to land in, from docs/WING-STAGE1.md, which derives each from published figures for a 1000 mm flying wing. Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

w1_level_65.source: level speed at 65 percent throttle, derived 18.53, re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 6 x 4E curve (prop curves, scripts/wing-derive.js), was 15.2 on the straight line; the band keeps its 11.2 percent under and 15.1 percent over, the room for the estimated inputs (was 13.5 to 17.5)

w4_top.source: level speed at full throttle, derived 28.74, re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 6 x 4E curve (prop curves, scripts/wing-derive.js), was 23.8 on the straight line; the band keeps its 7.6 percent under and 13.4 percent over (was 22 to 27)

w5_roll.source: full elevon at about 20 m/s, derived 250

w6_turn.source: radius against V^2 / (g tan bank) at the bank and speed flown

w7_climb.source: full throttle, best over a sweep of airspeeds, derived 17.92 at 16.2 m/s, re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 6 x 4E curve (prop curves, scripts/wing-derive.js), was 11.5 at 12.5 on the straight line; the band keeps its 30.4 percent under and 13.0 percent over (was 8 to 13)

w8_throw.source: a throw at 10 m/s, 60 percent, an eighth of up for two seconds; airborne and flying after three

w9_chop.source: throttle off from cruise, pitch stick neutral: a glide, not a tumble

w10_quad_hash.source: verify check 2's canonical replay hash of the five inch before the wing existed; the wing must not move it

w11_cross_host.source: the scripted flight's state trace hash, Node against headless Chrome
